title: UEI Definition
author: windwalk59-blip
body:
What is the UEI?   I assume it is Unique Entity Identifier, but is it CAGE code, DUNS number, a FEDRAMP generated ID#, etc.?   I do not see UEI listed in the FedRAMP Definitions.     I only see a reference to in is a discussion by [mblanco474](https://github.com/mblanco474)
[on Jun 3](https://github.com/FedRAMP/community/discussions/38#discussioncomment-17168964).

comments.author: pete-gov
comments.body:
> What is the UEI?

Ah, this isn't a FedRAMP/infosec thing, it's a government procurement thing.

The Unique Entity ID is a 12 character alphanumeric code [assigned by GSA through SAM.gov](https://sam.gov/entity-registration) to identify companies that do business with the government. It's not required for FedRAMP Certification but is a core part of actually doing any procurement with the government. 

Additional information about the UEI can be found at the [Federal Service Desk](https://www.fsd.gov/gsafsd_sp/en/entity-registration-what-s-the-difference-between-only-getting-a-unique?id=kb_article_view&sysparm_article=KB0051214) here.

comments.author: PeterWeiler
comments.body: We have two UEI numbers (multiple records in sam.gov).  I can list both in the human-readable version of CDS-CSO-PUB since it is free-form; but the JSON schema requires a single string.  What is the recommendation for handling this?  Is a comma or semicolon separated list provided as a single string preferred?  Should I provide an array of strings regardless of validation failure?

replies.author: pete-gov
replies.body:
> We have two UEI numbers (multiple records in sam.gov). I can list both in the human-readable version of CDS-CSO-PUB since it is free-form; but the JSON schema requires a single string. What is the recommendation for handling this? 

The UEI on the Marketplace is purely for the convenience of agencies and isn't something FedRAMP has a particular stake in - many (if not most) cloud services don't even supply it. I'd just pick one and then have your alternate numbers displayed on the human-readable version on your website. We'd have to rework stuff to support multiple UEI's and I don't think that juice is worth the squeeze. :)
